label: Multi-Jurisdiction Regulatory Comparison
description: Compares regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions for a specific topic (e.g., AML/CFT, GDPR, licensing). Identifies overlaps, conflicts, and strictest requirements.

claudeKnowledge.description: Multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements, national implementation measures, supervisory expectations

guidedInputs.label: Regulatory Topic / Question
guidedInputs.description: What regulatory topic or compliance question should be compared across jurisdictions?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. KYC requirements for corporate customers, specifically beneficial ownership identification thresholds, verification requirements, and documentation standards...

guidedInputs.label: Jurisdictions to Compare
guidedInputs.description: Select the jurisdictions to include in the comparison.

guidedInputs.label: Purpose of Comparison
guidedInputs.description: What is the primary purpose of this multi-jurisdiction comparison?

guidedInputs.label: Specific Requirements to Compare
guidedInputs.description: List specific aspects of the topic you want compared (or leave blank for a comprehensive comparison).
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Compare: (1) UBO ownership threshold %, (2) verification methods accepted, (3) register sources required, (4) refresh frequency, (5) senior managing official fallback requirements...

guidedInputs.label: Entity Type
guidedInputs.description: What type of entity does this comparison apply to?
